text: Arre suno suno! Bijli ka bill aaya hai... poore do sau baarah rupaye!
Haaye re... mera BP badh gaya!
Kisne chalaya pankha? Garmi lagti hai toh khidki kholo... hawa free hai!
Aur yeh AC? Yeh sirf mehmaanon ke liye hai... jo kabhi aate hi nahi!
Main kanjoos nahi hoon beta, bas paisa bachata hoon. Follow karo... woh bhi free hai!
